add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(ddraw.dll ddraw.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(ddraw registry ddraw_classes.idl)

# ddraw.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ddraw_shims OBJECT clipper.c ddraw.c device.c executebuffer.c light.c main.c material.c palette.c surface.c utils.c vertexbuffer.c viewport.c)
target_link_libraries(ddraw_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid libd3dwine libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(ddraw_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(ddraw_shims)
add_dependencies(ddraw_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
set(DDRAW_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/ddraw/ddraw_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(ddraw ddraw-cargo ddraw.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ddraw_shims psdk ddraw_r ${DDRAW_REUSED} uuid_sources)
